svg.title: Compression Selection and Nested VAE for Adaptive Compression
svg.desc: Complete native SVG reconstruction. Base frames: left compression-selection panel, optional image-pair panel, and right nested-VAE architecture panel. The left panel contains title, complexity labels, up-arrows, an orange LLM-evaluation bar, two example captions, dashed correspondence arrows, and two thumbnail illustrations. The right panel contains the VAE input beach thumbnail, encoder/decoder yellow feature pyramids, colored nested skip paths for 8x/16x/32x, latent mean/variance brackets, z sampling box, labels, dimension annotations, and legend. Symmetry basis: right architecture is approximately horizontally organized around central latent sampling, with encoder downsampling mirrored by decoder upsampling.

g.desc: Inside f01: title at top, purple low-complexity label on left, green high-complexity label on right, two upward arrows, an orange rounded LLM evaluation bar, two upward arrows from captions to the bar, and two typewriter captions. Inside f02: two illustrative thumbnails aligned below corresponding captions, dashed upward arrows, and optional note at lower right.
Native SVG approximation of a low-complexity beach image: blue sky, sea bands, sand, horizon, and tiny birds/people.
Native SVG approximation of a high-complexity desktop and monitor scene: wood background, desk, monitor, keyboard, cables, papers, and small objects.

Inside f03: the origin is the input image at left. Moving rightward: three yellow encoder downsampling blocks lead through nested green/blue/purple compression paths into a shared latent sampling region with μ and σ² bracket notation, then z sampling, then mirrored decoder upsampling blocks. Colored paths correspond to 8x green, 16x blue, and 32x purple, with legend at top right.
Input beach image, labeled 512x512, approximated with vector sky, ocean and sand.
